title: Analysis of epicardial genes in embryonic mouse hearts with flow cytometry
protocol: Cull the pregnant female mouse using approved methods such as cervical dislocation.
Remove the uterine horn containing mouse embryos and place it in a Petri dish with ice cold PBS.
Separate each embryo from the uterine wall, membranes, and visceral yolk sac to expose the embryo.
Inspect embryonic anatomy to assess and confirm the developmental stage.
Excise the heart from the embryo and remove the outflow tract.
Remove all traces of the pericardium, especially present on hearts of later developmental stages (≥E15.5).
Submerge hearts in an enzyme mix and mount C-tube to an automated dissociator.
Neutralize the enzymatic reaction and filter the cell suspension.
Observe a small faint red cell pellet before RBC lysis.
Observe a small white cell pellet after RBC lysis.
Count viable cells with 0.4% trypan blue solution; cell shape and size may vary between cells.
Inspect embryonic anatomy to assess and confirm the developmental stage.
Excise hearts from embryos.
Remove the outflow tract from excised hearts.
Remove the pericardium from excised hearts.
Transfer directly into pre-cooled C-tubes containing cold PBS.
Separate R26tdTom;Wt1CreERT2/+ genotype hearts under the red fluorescence channel.
Ensure reporter-labeled hearts are separated from unlabeled hearts for lineage tracing.
Take some unlabeled hearts and dissociate them for single-color compensation.
Prepare fluorescence minus one (FMO) controls by leaving out one of the fluorochrome-conjugated antibodies/RNA probes used in staining.
Keep C-tubes containing hearts on ice (+4°C) throughout harvest.
Thaw Neonatal Heart Dissociation Kit enzymes on ice as needed for processing embryonic hearts.
Prepare enzyme mix as per manufacturer’s instructions for the Neonatal Heart Dissociation Kit protocol.
Remove supernatant (PBS) carefully from C-tubes containing embryonic hearts using a fine tip plastic Pasteur pipette.
Add 2.5 mL of enzyme mix to each C-tube.
Invert tubes to ensure all hearts are submerged in solution.
Attach the C-tubes onto the sleeve of the gentleMACS Octo Dissociator with Heaters.
Run program 37C_mr_NHDK_1 for 60 minutes.
If using a gentleMACS dissociator without heaters, follow manufacturer’s alternative instructions.
Incubate enzyme mix on heated racks or in an incubator at 37°C with mechanical agitation every 15 minutes for 45 minutes total.
Agitate the mixture gently for 30 seconds each time.
After completion of enzymatic digestion, detach C-tubes from dissociator.
Add 7.5 mL of cold culture medium (DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS) to terminate enzymatic reaction.
Centrifuge C-tubes briefly at 100 × g for 1 minute to collect solution from caps.
Resuspend sample using a plastic Pasteur pipette and transfer immediately to a 50 mL tube fitted with a 70 μm strainer.
Wash C-tubes and strainers with 3 mL of cold cell culture medium.
Use the thumb press end of a 2 mL syringe plunger rod as a pestle to push tissue clumps through the strainer.
Collect everything from under the strainer using a pipette before discarding.
Discard used strainers.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 600 × g for 5 minutes at +10°C.
Remove supernatant completely.
Resuspend cell pellet in 500 μL of cold PEB buffer.
Transfer the 500 μL cell suspension to 15 mL tubes.
Wash 50 mL tubes with another 500 μL of cold PEB and transfer to corresponding tube.
Prepare 1× red blood cell lysis solution with ultrapure DNase/RNase-free distilled water.
Add 10 mL of 1× red blood cell lysis solution to each sample.
Incubate for 2 min at 20°C–24°C.
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 5 min at +10°C.
Prepare Enzyme A solution in PBS.
Remove supernatant and gently resuspend cell pellet in 1 mL Enzyme A solution by resuspending twice with a pipette.
Make up to 10 mL volume by adding 9 mL Enzyme A solution to each sample.
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 5 min at +10°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellet in 500 μL cold cell staining buffer.
Keep samples on ice (+2°C to +4°C).
Take a sample of cells to perform manual cell counts using a hemocytometer.
Add 10 mL PBS to each sample.
Invert to mix and centrifuge at 600 × g for 5 min at +4°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellet in 300 μL diluted Zombie Aqua Fixable Viability Dye solution (1:1,000 in PBS).
Transfer samples to 1.5 mL tubes and incubate for 30 min at 20°C–24°C, protected from light.
Add 1 mL of cold cell staining buffer.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at +4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Proceed to cell surface antibody staining procedure.
Add 200 μL 70% ethanol to the 100 μL cell suspension.
Vortex samples twice in 5 s pulses.
Incubate samples for 2 min at 20°C–24°C.
Add 500 μL of PBS and centrifuge at 800 × g for 5 min at +4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in 100 μL residual volume.
Repeat the PBS wash step.
Stain with Aqua fixable viability dye after washing.
Fix sample in IC fixation buffer by adding 100 μL IC fixation buffer to 100 μL stained cell suspension.
Store fixed samples at 2°C–8°C, protected from light.
Resuspend cell pellet in 100 μL diluted BV421 anti-CD31 antibody (1:50 in cell staining buffer).
Incubate for 30 min on ice (+2°C to +4°C), protected from light.
Add 1 mL of cold cell staining buffer and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at +4°C.
Discard supernatant, keeping 100 μL residual volume.
Resuspend cells in the residual volume.
Proceed to cell fixation and permeabilization for intracellular antigen staining.
Add 1 mL of PrimeFlow RNA fixation buffer 1, invert to mix and incubate for 30 min on ice (+2°C to +4°C), protected from light.
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 5 min at +4°C and discard supernatant, keeping 100 μL residual volume.
Resuspend cells in residual volume by vortexing.
Add 1 mL of PrimeFlow RNA permeabilization buffer supplemented with RNase inhibitors, invert to mix and centrifuge at 800 × g for 7 min at +4°C.
Discard supernatant, keeping 100 μL residual volume.
Resuspend cells in residual volume by vortexing.
Repeat wash as in step c.
Add 100 μL diluted BV421 anti-cTnT antibody (1:100 in PrimeFlow RNA permeabilization buffer + RNase inhibitors) to 100 μL cell suspension (final Ab dilution 1:200).
Incubate for 30 min on ice (+2°C to +4°C), protected from light.
Repeat Perm wash as in step c.
Add 1 mL of PrimeFlow RNA fixation buffer 2.
Invert to mix.
Incubate for 12–20 h at 2°C–8°C, protected from light.
Take some cells from allocated control samples to generate FMOs before staining for intracellular markers.
Use PrimeFlow RNA Tubes and/or PrimeFlow 96-well plate when carrying out the PrimeFlow RNA assay.
Hybridize Wt1, Sema3d, Tbx18, Tcf21, and Scx probes for mRNA staining using a commercially available in situ hybridization assay for flow cytometry.
Centrifuge samples at 800 × g for 7 minutes at 20°C–24°C.
Discard supernatant, keeping 100 μL residual volume.
Resuspend cells in the residual volume by vortexing.
Add 1 mL of PrimeFlow RNA wash buffer, invert to mix.
Centrifuge samples at 800 × g for 7 minutes at 20°C–24°C.
Discard supernatant, keeping 100 μL residual volume.
Resuspend cells in the residual volume by vortexing.
Repeat wash as described previously.
If targeting 100,000 cells per probe panel, adjust total sample volume with PrimeFlow RNA wash buffer to achieve a cell concentration of 500,000 cells/mL.
Divide sample into staining panels and transfer 200 μL of cell suspension into corresponding wells of a PrimeFlow 96-well plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 1,000 × g for 7 minutes at 20°C–24°C using an adhesive plate film to cover.
Discard supernatant by inverting the plate with sufficient force and blotting on paper towel.
Briefly vortex cells in the ~10 μL residual volume.
Add 50 μL of PrimeFlow wash buffer to each well.
Add 50 μL diluted target probes (1:20 in Target Probe Diluent) to corresponding wells as indicated.
Incubate plate with the lid on for 2 hours at 40°C.
Place plate into the center of the humidity control tray if using the HybEZ oven.
Modify centrifugation time to 7 minutes as per manufacturer’s instructions in Appendix 7 from step 26 (PrimeFlow RNA assay).
Add 50 μL of PrimeFlow RNA PreAmp Mix to 50 μL cell suspension.
Add 50 μL of PrimeFlow RNA Amp Mix to the mixture.
Add 50 μL of PrimeFlow RNA Label Probes to the mixture.
Store samples in IC fixation buffer (100 μL cell suspension in PrimeFlow RNA storage buffer + 100 μL IC fixation buffer).
Keep stored samples at 2°C–8°C, dark and sealed with an adhesive plate film.
Acquire data within 3 days.
Allocate wells for corresponding target probe FMOs and divide control sample accordingly.
Ensure no fewer than 50,000 cells are used per target probe FMO control sample.
Prepare unstained, Aqua dye, and tdTomato single-color compensation controls on day 1 using cells.
Prepare BV421, Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 568, Alexa Fluor 647, and Alexa Fluor 750 single-color controls on day 2 using appropriate compensation beads.
Add fluorochrome-conjugated antibody or 5 μL PrimeFlow Compensation Control to 100 μL compensation bead suspension and incubate for 15–30 min on ice.
Add 1 mL of PBS and centrifuge at 600 × g for 5 min at +4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend beads in 100 μL residual volume.
Add 100 μL IC Fixation buffer to the 100 μL stained bead suspension.
Fix all single-color compensation controls before storing at +4°C, protected from light.
Wash compensation controls with cell staining buffer.
Resuspend washed controls in 300 μL of cell staining buffer.
Transfer the resuspended controls to 5 mL flow cytometry tubes.
Centrifuge a PrimeFlow 96-well plate containing samples and FMOs at 1,000 × g for 7 minutes at +4°C.
Discard the supernatant from the centrifuged plate.
Resuspend cells in each well with 220 μL of cell staining buffer.
Transfer resuspended cells to V-bottom 96-well polypropylene plates for data collection.
Place tubes and plates on ice (+2°C to +4°C) while protecting them from light.
Set up PMT voltages for forward-scatter, side-scatter (FSC/SSC), and fluorescence channels.
Use an unstained cell sample that has undergone the PrimeFlow assay to set up FSC/SSC.
Collect all cells of interest on scale during acquisition.
Eliminate debris during data collection.
Adjust PMT voltages accordingly using unstained, single-color stained, and full panel samples.
Set compensation based on adjusted PMT voltages.
Acquire and record at least 1,000 positively single-color stained cells for Aqua dye compensation.
Remove sample and replace with unstained cell sample, then append recording.
Repeat the process for tdTomato single-color control.
Acquire remaining compensation samples as usual.
Check compensation settings.
Set up plate-based acquisition.
Select V-bottom setting.
Set throughput mode to “Standard.”
Keep sample flow rate consistent between wells.
Set number of mixes and wash volume to maximum.
Acquire and record all possible events in the total cells gate (P1).
Resuspend settled cells with a multichannel before loading plate.
Start collection and analysis of FMOs and samples.
Collect and analyze samples during the same flow cytometry session for quantifying and comparing transcript levels between samples.
Prepare FMOs for each developmental stage.
Prepare FMOs for each independent experiment.
